about: Abakan International Airport, address: 59 Druzhby Narodov Ave, Abakan. From 25 October 2026 the terminal is open from 04:30 to 22:00. Information desk (3902) 202-489.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus No. 106, trolleybuses No. 3, No. 4 and No. 5. Taxi: Maxim +7 (3902) 28-28-28, Khoroshee +7 (3902) 30-07-00, Troika +7 (3902) 23-33-33.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Premium comfort lounge in the right wing of the terminal, 05:00–22:00, up to 3 hours. Economy class: adult 5,000 ₽, child under 12 2,500 ₽, under 2 free. Business class and lounge access programmes: 2,700 ₽ per adult. Phone +7 913 449-38-26.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room in the left wing of the terminal, next to the first-aid post. Bedroom, playroom, kitchen, changing table. For children under 7; passport and boarding pass required. Free of charge. Phone (3902) 202-551.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: The paid long-stay car park 50 m to the right of the terminal is temporarily closed.
